test_title: PYST 35: RRB Group D - GA (Held On: 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Monika Gusain won a senior executive post in which of the following Indian associations?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Supreme Court Bar Association**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Monika Gusain** was elected as a **Senior Executive Member** of the **Supreme Court Bar Association (SCBA)** in the elections held for the **2024-2025** term.
 
• The **SCBA election**, which took place in **May 2024**, is one of the most prestigious events for the legal fraternity in India, determining the leadership of the advocates practicing at the **apex court**.
 
• She is a practicing **Advocate-on-Record (AOR)** in the **Supreme Court of India**, a specialized category of lawyers authorized to file matters before the court.
 
• The **2024** elections were particularly significant as they saw the return of veteran lawyer and former Union Minister **Kapil Sibal** as the **President** of the **Supreme Court Bar Association** after several years.
 
• The executive committee of the **SCBA** consists of various posts, including **President**, **Vice President**, **Honorary Secretary**, and several **Executive Members** (both **Senior** and **Junior**) who manage the affairs of the association.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Supreme Court Bar Association (SCBA)**:
 
 
• The **SCBA** is an entity that represents the collective interests of the lawyers practicing in the **Supreme Court of India**, located in **New Delhi**.
 
• It plays a critical role in maintaining the **independence of the judiciary** and ensuring the welfare of the legal community.
 
• The **SCBA** is involved in organizing legal seminars, maintaining library facilities for members, and acting as a liaison between the **Judges (the Bench)** and the **Lawyers (the Bar)**.
 
 
 
• **Other Organizations Mentioned**:
 
 
• **Asian Rural Development Organization (AARDO)**: An autonomous **inter-governmental organization** established in **1962** to promote welfare and **rural development** among its member countries in **Africa** and **Asia**.
 
• **Indian Institute of Architects (IIA)**: The national body of **architects** in India, established in **1917**, which plays a major role in the promotion of the profession of **architecture**.
 
• **National Association of Realtors - India (NAR-INDIA)**: The apex body for **real estate consultants** in India, formed to provide a single platform for **realtors** to promote ethical practices in the **real estate sector**.
 
 
 
• **Advocate-on-Record (AOR) System**:
 
 
• Under the **Supreme Court Rules, 2013**, only an **Advocate-on-Record** is entitled to file any appearance or act for a party in the **Supreme Court**.
 
• To become an **AOR**, an advocate must have at least **four years** of practice and pass a rigorous examination conducted by the **Supreme Court of India**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The **SCBA Executive Committee** for **2024-2025** includes **Kapil Sibal** as **President**, **Rachana Srivastava** as **Vice President**, and **Vikrant Yadav** as **Honorary Secretary**.
 
• The election of **Monika Gusain** as a **Senior Executive Member** highlights the active participation of women in the leadership roles of the **legal profession** in India.
 
• The **Supreme Court of India** was inaugurated on **January 28, 1950**, succeeding the **Federal Court of India** established under the **Government of India Act, 1935**.
